scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
other_conditions: Must be an Indian national with valid proof of nationality
Must possess a valid Aadhaar card (exemptions apply for states where Aadhaar is not fully implemented)
Must have an Aadhaar‑linked bank account
Must register on the Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH)
Must achieve at least 70% biometric attendance during training assessments
For OBC and EWS applicants, annual family income must be below ₹3,00,000; no income limit for SC, DNT and Safai Mitras
benefits_summary: Free training funded 100% by the government, with stipends during the program and certification plus placement assistance after successful completion.
